features.title: Unreal Engine 5 World
features.description: Explore a fully rendered environment built in Unreal Engine 5, where every detail is designed to pull you in.

steps.title: Enter the world
steps.description: Drop into the Unreal Engine 5 environment and start exploring, talking to NPCs and uncovering what is there to find.

items.question: What is New game?
items.answer: New game is a hobby entertainment project built in Unreal Engine 5. Its main purpose is fun — there is no grand competitive ladder, just an immersive world to enjoy.

items.question: Why does it use a separate NPC server?
items.answer: Running NPC logic on a dedicated server means characters can be more responsive and consistent, without putting extra load on your own machine.

items.question: Do I need a high-end PC to play?
items.answer: Unreal Engine 5 performs best on modern hardware. Check the minimum specs listed on the download page before installing.

items.question: Is this a multiplayer game?
items.answer: The NPC server connects you to a shared world of characters, but the current build is focused on a solo experience with reactive NPCs.

items.question: Is New game free?
items.answer: New game is a hobby project — details about access and any future cost will be shared on the launch page.
